Service demand, the utilization law and the bottleneck bound

Di=Vi×SiUi=X×DiXmax=ciDmaxD_i = V_i \times S_i \qquad U_i = X \times D_i \qquad X_{max} = \frac{c_i}{D_{max}}

Symbol Meaning Units

The utilization law for a resource with cic_i parallel units is Ui=X×Di/ciU_i = X \times D_i / c_i. The bottleneck is the resource with the largest Di/ciD_i / c_i.
